messages.subject: Thank you (and one small thing)
messages.body:
Hi Odessa,

We're still floating after Saturday. Thank you for everything, the lanterns along the path were magic and my mom hasn't stopped talking about the cake.

One small thing, and I only mention it because you asked for honest feedback: a lot of guests at the back tables told us they couldn't hear the toasts at all. My uncle said it was just echo off the roof beams. Kestrel Barn is gorgeous but the sound was a mess past the dance floor.

It didn't ruin anything, promise. Thank you again!

Priya

messages.subject: Re: Thank you (and one small thing)
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you so much, it was a joy to plan with you both. And thank you for telling me about the toasts. I'm sorry the back tables missed them. I'll look into what we can do about the sound in that barn for future events.

Warmly,
Odessa

messages.subject: Retreat debrief + spring kickoff
messages.body:
Hi Odessa,

The team survey from the retreat is in. Food and the hike scored great. The weak spot was the all-hands: half the room said they couldn't follow Ravi's talk because of the echo in the barn, and a few people just gave up and checked email.

We're starting to plan the spring kickoff (about 90 people) and would like to use Kestrel Barn again since everyone loved the setting, but only if the audio problem is solved. Can you send a recommendation when you have one?

Best,
Lena Varga
People Operations, Corvid Software

messages.subject: Barn delay-speaker kit
messages.body:
Hey Odessa,

Quick one. After a few rough rooms this fall we built a delay-speaker kit for long timber barns: two extra column speakers halfway down the room on a short delay, plus a small mixer so speeches stay clear at the back. We tested it at Kestrel Barn last week with their manager and the difference is night and day.

It's a $380/day add-on to any of our packages. Let me know if you want it on any upcoming bookings.

Cheers,
Felix
Brightline AV

messages.subject: Re: Thank you (and one small thing)

messages.subject: Enrollment confirmed: Theo, Level 4
messages.body: Theo is enrolled in Level 4, Tuesdays at 4:30 pm, starting Jan 12.

messages.subject: Car inspection
messages.body: The minivan's inspection is due by Dec 15, so I booked it for the 8th at Delgado's garage. Just so you know. J

messages.subject: Package
messages.body: Hi, a package for you got left on our porch, I put it by your door. P.

messages.subject: Re: December book
messages.body: Small change: we're starting at 7:30 instead of 7. See you there! Lydia

messages.subject: Winter programs are open
messages.body: Ice skating lessons, indoor soccer and family yoga. Sign up online today, spots are limited.

messages.subject: Your photos are ready
messages.body: Your 36 prints are ready for pickup. Thanks for printing with us!

messages.subject: Picture day order form
messages.body: Hi Odessa, Theo's picture day order form didn't come back. Could you send it in this week? Thank you, Dana

messages.subject: Re: Picture day order form
messages.body:
Sorry! It's in his backpack today.

Odessa

messages.subject: Tournament carpool
messages.body: Hi Odessa, can you drive two kids to Saturday's tournament in Fairport? We leave the clubhouse at 8. Marco

messages.subject: Re: Tournament carpool
messages.body: Yes, I can take two. See you at 8.

messages.subject: First dance timing
messages.body: Hi Odessa, could we move the first dance to right before dinner instead of after? My grandparents tend to leave early. Thanks! Priya

messages.subject: Re: First dance timing
messages.body:
Absolutely, I'll update the timeline and let the band know.

Odessa

messages.subject: Your policy renews Jan 1
messages.body: Your general liability policy renews on Jan 1. Log in to view your documents and request certificates.

messages.subject: Proof: Ferreira save-the-dates
messages.body:
Hi Odessa, proof attached for the Ferreira save-the-dates. Please check names and the date, then approve and tell me the quantity.

Wendell

messages.subject: Re: Proof: Ferreira save-the-dates
messages.body: Approved, please print 120. Thanks Wendell!

messages.subject: Re: Coffee?
messages.body:
Thanks for coffee! Here's the pricing sheet template I mentioned. Steal anything you like.

Ros

messages.subject: See you Nov 14
messages.body: Your booth is B12. Load-in from 7 am. Bring your own extension cords.

messages.subject: Thanksgiving groceries
messages.body: Can you pick up cranberries and a bag of ice on your way home? I've got everything else. J

messages.subject: Winter concert seating
messages.body: Seating for the winter concert is first come, first served. Doors open at 5:30 pm.

messages.subject: Thank you + photos
messages.body:
Hi Odessa,

The launch photos are lovely, thank you. Our director wants to do the spring catalog party with you too, date to be decided. Can you send a rough estimate for about 150 guests?

Ruth

opportunities.what: Two clients (Priya's wedding, Corvid retreat) say speeches were lost to echo at Kestrel Barn; Felix now has a $380/day barn delay-speaker kit tested there. Add it to the Halloway wedding there (Jan 16) and the Corvid kickoff proposal, and tell Priya and Lena about the fix.

Bloomhaven's centerpiece price went $58 to $68 to $74 plus an 8% surcharge across two invoices; Juniper Moss quotes $56 with no surcharge, held through June. Move recurring centerpiece orders or use the quote to renegotiate.
Northgate (Fri Dec 11, ~$900) and Calloway (Sat Dec 12, ~$800) both want a photo booth; SpinFrame does two consecutive days for $1,400. Book one two-day rental, $700 per event, under both budgets.

The Vandermeer tasting is Fri Dec 4 at 11:00 at Silverspoon, but Desmond moved the gala walkthrough to Dec 4, 10:30-12:30, and needs Odessa there. Move the tasting and tell the couple before confirming Desmond.

Dad lands at Harlow Dec 20 at 4:10 pm and Clara with the boys at 5:25 pm the same day. One airport run picks up all of them, so Dad skips the bus and Clara skips a $70/day rental; reply to both with one plan.

Theo must be at the school concert by 5:15 pm on Dec 10, but the Hawks team photo and party run 5:00-6:30 pm that night. Ask Coach Marco to shoot the team photo first, and return the concert form by Dec 4.

traps.what: Two people with the first name Nadia both ask about late-night options, but one is a wedding client at Fenwick Gardens and the other is a hotel sales manager announcing rates; unrelated.
The word Orchard links the Orchard Lodge hold for the Pemberton wedding and an Orchard Analytics invoice fix; unrelated matters.
PopCloud's 10% second-order discount on a work quote could cover Ivy's party balloons, but that joins a work vendor deal with a family thread.
Caterer warned of a server shortage and the client asked about staffing, but the caterer confirmed full staffing and Odessa told the client.
Pitching Larchwood's midweek package for Fernhill's offsite is tempting, but there is no date or budget yet (no date anywhere), so a proposal would invent one; a reply to Patrick is enough.
Two venues need a certificate of insurance; an open to-do already asks the insurer for both.
Two band-volume complaints are one client, Graham, writing from his work and personal addresses.
Linen price rises appear only in a newsletter and a marketplace notification.
A client wanted a calligrapher for invitations due Oct 5 and a calligrapher pitched herself, but that deadline passed nearly two months ago.
